name: Trumpet
author: Versilian Studios (samples); DAW build script
attribution: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition (Sam Gossner / Versilian Studios), CC0 1.0
desc: Solo trumpet, straight sustain, 2 dynamics. Bright, bold, penetrating. Range E3-D6 (best C4-C6). Fanfares, lead lines, brass stabs with short notes. | Playable MIDI 52-86 (E3-D6), 2 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity). Legato melody: overlap consecutive notes by ~30 ms (next note starts before the previous ends) with glide 0.03-0.06; wide leaps crossfade naturally (legato=1), legato=0 = pure slide.
